fingerprint: first 4 and last 4 characters of the Figma file key, joined by an ellipsis. A hint for matching by plain string comparison; the remaining characters are not stored. Never store file keys or links here.
hashAlgorithm: optional strict check: sha256 of the file key, first 16 hex characters (scripts/resolve-area.sh)
note: Resolve by fingerprint with the Read tool only (areas/README.md). Never store file keys or links here.

roles: release = published library (prior art to read); design = work-in-progress file where designs are merged; working-copy = a copy seen in a ticket. A release file's integratesInto names the design file to merge into; a design file integrates into itself.
